notes:
Achievements without a Steam API key. Nyxen now reads your achievements from
your own Steam profile page, so there is no key to create and nothing to
paste - it offers the accounts Steam has already signed in on your PC and you
pick one. A key stays optional and buys only two things: games you own but
have not installed, and reading a profile that is not public.

Updates inside the app. It checks for a new version, tells you what changed,
and installs it with one button. The download is checked against its
published SHA-256 before anything is run.

Letting a friend in is one button. Nyxen opens the tunnel itself - no terminal
window, no port forwarding, no router settings - and the invite link now
carries the address, so the person you send it to does not have to type
anything either.
